title.zh: Agentic Data Stack 杭州 Meetup

description.en: Our first in-person meetup brings developers and practitioners together to discuss Data Agents, data infrastructure, and the challenges of building real systems.
description.zh: 社区首次线下交流将从杭州开始。邀请开发者与企业实践者围绕 Data Agent 和数据基础设施的实际问题展开分享与讨论，认识共同建设社区的伙伴。

venue.en: Hangzhou · Venue details will be shared on Luma.
venue.zh: 杭州 · 具体场地请关注 Luma 活动页。

registrationNote.en: Free to attend. Registration is subject to host approval.
registrationNote.zh: 免费参加，报名需经主办方审核。

formats.en: Session formats and durations will be announced with the call.
formats.zh: 分享形式与时长将在征集开放时公布。

title.en: Agentic Data Stack: technical evolution & why this community (tentative)
title.zh: Agentic Data Stack：技术演进与社区初衷（暂定）
